pairs.registryProposal: module-depth's closed-set detection signal ('a routine that matches on the content of a text parameter') also catches produce.ts:94 leanOf, which parses words written by relDur/relUsd in the same module. It does this on purpose, so there is only one threshold. The signal could exempt matching on text whose only writer is the same module.
